notes:
W5 on PR #787 head cf8c3cc7, two commits on branch fix-w5-20261110 (63c26995, f8499fad). PART 1, published runtime (patch 0001): js/prim3-mission/released-app.mjs and released-learning.mjs imported PRIM3/game/halo/adaptive/topology-learning.mjs, which deploy-pages.yml strips with the rest of PRIM3/. Done the way W1 promoted the recipe compiler: the runtime is copied byte-identical to js/prim3-mission/topology-learning.mjs (git: 100% copy), the two published importers, the Worker (workers/mccluster/src/prim3/adaptive-learning.js) and the unit test import it, and the private path becomes a one-line `export *` shim so PRIM3/game/halo/adaptive/engine.mjs, which imports './topology-learning.mjs', keeps resolving to the same module (the engine itself is unchanged). js/prim3-mission/** is already a path of prim3-adaptive-postgres.yml, so no workflow trigger changes. The Equity Uprise source map entry moves with the file (the shim no longer names the product) and the generated coverage report is regenerated: still 640 candidates and 2458/2458 checks. PART 2, teaching frame (patch 0002): the HQ, B1 defend and B1 attack frames said '3.54 m/tile'. Their level module (js/prim3-tactics/levels/equity-uprise-hq.mjs, re-exported by equity-uprise-b1.mjs) lays the plan at FT_PER_TILE = 12 ft and draws the level at WORLD_M = 12 x 0.3048 = 3.6576 m a cell; the rules keep TILE_M = 3.54 m (the module's own words, and PROJECT-STATE.md: 'HQ adapter 12 ft cells, tactics 3.54 m tiles'). The frames now read 'X=x−3, Y=8−y; +X east, +Y north; one cell is 12 ft (3.6576 m) on the building plan; tactical rules use the separate 3.54 m game tile'. Transit / Relay (drawn and ruled on TILE_M), the generated operation, the courtyard and the City are unchanged. Only display text moves: the frame appears in the brief and in the question prompt, never in the signed result (hint and feedback strings, expected answers and prim3.lattice-learning/v1 are unchanged), so existing signed sessions replay unchanged and no version bump is needed. The parity test reads FRAME, WORLD_M, TILE_M, FT and FT_PER_TILE from the Transit, HQ and B1 level modules; docs/prim3/TOPOLOGY-LEARNING.md records the runtime's location and the two scales. EQUITY UPRISE GATE: the frame text states the building's plan scale, so docs/design/equity-uprise-building/AGENTS.md and README.md were read and audit_building_context.py run (PASS) before editing, and the frame and scale passages of PROJECT-STATE.md and REFERENCE-AUTHORITY.md were checked; no geometry, plan, floor, program or capability changes, so the rest of that preflight was not read in full. FINDINGS FOR THE LEAD: (1) The published reviewed-mission page of #787 is broken twice over: by this W5 import and by the W1 import (released-app.mjs -> js/prim3-tactics/levels/generated.mjs -> PRIM3/game/halo/generated/recipe.mjs) that only the audit branch fixes; with this series alone the published page still fails, at recipe.mjs. It works once #787 is rebased onto #793 with this series (8/8 journeys from the published merged tree). (2) Merging the audit branch into #787 (git merge, the combined state tested here) conflicts only in the two generated Equity Uprise records; the union of map entries plus a regenerated report resolves it (696 candidates, 2682/2682), and the series then also applies with git am -3, giving the same tree as merging the series head (b8ee2991). A literal rebase is not that small: git rebase replays #787's five non-merge commits and stops at the first, 27f9f5d1, with conflicts in prim3-released-mission.html, scripts/test/prim3-mission-client.test.mjs and scripts/test/prim3-released-learning.test.mjs (which #787's own merges of main had resolved); git rebase --rebase-merges stops at the recreated cf8c3cc7 merge with those three plus the two generated records (evidence/skeptic-verification.log). OBSERVATIONS, NOT CHANGED (outside W5): every non-City question joins the frame and the sentence with no full stop ('... 3.54 m game tile On an unobstructed ...'; the same on the PR head with '3.54 m/tile On'), because latticeQuestion() writes `${axes} On ...` and the variant frames end without one; docs/prim3/ADAPTIVE-MISSION-ENGINE.md still says engine.mjs has no dependencies, stale since #787 added the topology import. TOOLING: Playwright 1.63.0 from /opt/node-tools, Chromium /opt/pw-browsers/chromium (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12), three 0.180.0 from an earlier scratch install (the version the journeys assert); node 22.23.4; git 2.43.0. The scratch scripts used are in evidence/ (topology-e2e-driver.mjs, memory-rest.mjs, the serve-root journey variant and its diff, build-export.sh, combined-check.sh, union_source_map.py, mutations.py); the driver gained its W5_JOURNEY switch after the first head run (same code path otherwise), and the repeat run used the final driver. Commits carry the repository's configured git identity as author and committer, as in the other series.
